notes.title: Betrayal of Blood is available for wishlist/purchase!
notes.content:
[h1]Betrayal of Blood is now released![/h1]

Our next RPG in the Strength & Virtue series is now live and available for wishlist/purchase! A huge thank-you to everyone who has supported the project thus far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43113031/9b0c6b378e3fa3d2172c172656d61ae14093b75a.png[/img]

An atmospheric 2.5D RPG that follows Thallia, a 15-year old girl from a formerly prosperous family, having her world upended when her father sells her off to the Labour Force for a few measly coins. Time to decide: slavery or freedom!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2355010/Betrayal_of_Blood_a_Strength__Virtue_RPG/#:~:text=An%20atmospheric%202.5D%20RPG,to%20decide%3A%20slavery%20or%20freedom!] Check it out here![/url]

Canonically, Betrayal of Blood is set some 300 years prior to the events of Trials of the Romer and Lord of Midchester, when slavery and rigid class systems still dominate the upper portions of Midland. It serves to provide yet another perspective on the region of Midland, and the world of Taharen as a whole.

Love you guys!
_Ross

notes.title: The World of Taharan is Expanding!
notes.content:
[h1]The World of Taharen is Expanding![/h1]

[h2]You can grab 'Lord of Midchester' for 15% off, and if you're interested, check out the latest release in the 'Strength & Virtue' EGU (extended game universe)![/h2]

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/2276100/Strength__Virtue_Trials_of_the_Romer/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43113031/3dcf3f00125d07817466533774ebc14146d52a3d.png[/img][/url]

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/2276100/Strength__Virtue_Trials_of_the_Romer/]Trials of the Romer[/url] is A 2.5D atmospheric survival RPG with active-time battles in which you play as a Nomad of the wasteland. After he saves a city-dweller, he begins to question everything he once believed. There is no easy path here, only a brutal landscape that only the strongest can survive.

Set immediately after the events of [i]Lord of Midchester[/i], this new title presents us with new pieces in the mystery that is the World of Taharen.

[h3]What's next for Midland and Taharen?[/h3]
Our next project explores the 'Great and Glorious' city of Victorium's exploitation of the lower classes in the build-up to the Peasant's Revolution. Told through the eyes of Thallia, a 15-year old girl sold into an indenture contract by her good-for-nothing father. Will Thallia manage to attain her freedom?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43113031/79f752ec9691f7a0b05308109cb9c7b3d23108a0.png[/img]

Thanks for playing. I really, truly, absolutely appreciate it!
[i]_Ross[/i]
